items.title: Nasdaq posts another record close as Micron and AI-related shares lead
items.summary: AI optimism remained the dominant US equity factor on Sep22, strengthening the transmission setup into Japan's Sep24 reopen.

items.title: Oil falls to two-week low as Gulf supply outlook improves
items.summary: Saudi East-West pipeline restart and improving Saudi/Gulf flows reduced supply-risk premium; WTI Oct settled $93.30 and the more-active Nov contract was around $90.01.

items.title: Meta Muse momentum reinforces AI monetization narrative
items.summary: Rapid adoption and monetization expectations for Meta's Muse strengthened the market narrative that AI capex can translate into consumer revenue, supporting chip and data-center value chains.

items.title: Alibaba unveils new AI chip and larger model; shares jump
items.summary: Alibaba announced a higher-performance AI chip, a much larger model roadmap and data-center capacity expansion, reinforcing global AI infrastructure demand but also highlighting China localization/competition risk.

items.title: Yen weakness keeps intervention risk elevated after BOJ hike
items.summary: The yen remained weak after the BOJ hike as markets questioned follow-up tightening; intervention vigilance remains a reversal risk for exporter and Nikkei-heavy positioning.

items.title: TSE cash closed Sep21-Sep23; OSE holiday derivatives open
items.summary: Three consecutive cash-market holidays concentrate overseas price discovery into the Sep24 reopen, increasing both gap and fade risk.

deduplication: Reuters/FISCO/Yahoo/SBI reproductions are consolidated to the original source where identifiable.
